title: MapHub: Daily Relevance Heatmaps of New arXiv Preprints for a Research Community
abstract: arXiv:2611.07174v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: MapHub, the MIDAS arXiv Preprint Hub, assesses each day's new arXiv submissions for every participant in a research community, with a large language model reading each paper against portfolios built for the participants. It publishes the relevance scores, from 0 to 100, as a heatmap that shows whose work each paper touches. In the authors' blind ratings, the top 10\% of papers by MapHub's scores held about 70\% of the raters' own top 5\%, pooled, against about a third for a text-matching baseline. About 6\% of a day's astro-ph papers reach 30 for each participant, and one every three days reaches 60. MapHub runs on a standard Claude subscription and is designed to be useful for any field: https://github.com/kailicao/maphub-public.

translated_title: MapHub：面向研究社区的每日新arXiv预印本相关性热图
translated_abstract: MapHub（MIDAS arXiv预印本中心）会为研究社区中的每位参与者评估每天新提交的arXiv论文，由大型语言模型阅读每篇论文，并将其与为参与者构建的研究组合进行比对。它将0到100分的相关性评分以热图形式发布，直观展示每篇论文触及了社区中哪些成员的工作。在作者的盲评实验中，按MapHub评分排名前10%的论文包含了评审者自己选出的前5%论文（汇总统计）的约70%，而文本匹配基线方法仅能达到约三分之一。每天astro-ph类别的论文中约6%对每位参与者的评分达到30分，平均每三天有一篇论文达到60分。MapHub运行在标准的Claude订阅之上，并设计为可适用于任何研究领域。
tldr: MapHub利用大语言模型每日评估新arXiv论文与研究社区中每位成员研究组合的相关性，并以热图形式呈现，其高分论文可覆盖评审者盲选前5%论文的约70%，显著优于文本匹配基线，且适用于任何研究领域。
en_tdlr: MapHub uses a large language model to daily assess the relevance of new arXiv preprints to each member of a research community based on their research portfolios, presenting results as heatmaps; its top-scored papers capture about 70% of raters' blind top-5% picks, far outperforming a text-matching baseline, and it works for any field.
